subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API & secure delivery options
messages:
From: Maya Singh <security@skylarkhealth.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: it-ops@skylarkhealth.com (Carlos Mendes)
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report and sharing method

Hi Sergio,

We are updating our vendor security evidence and need the most recent penetration test report that covers the Hosted API (production endpoints). Can you share the latest PT report and a recommended secure transfer method (we prefer ephemeral links or portal access rather than email attachments)?

Also helpful to include:
- the scope (which hosts, services, and endpoints were tested),
- whether customer data was in scope, and
- a remediation tracker or summary of open findings + fixed items.

We have a standard NDA in place, but if you require a separate agreement for full report access please let us know. Our security team prefers either: a short-lived presigned S3 link, an access-controlled evidence portal, or an SFTP account with MFA.

Thanks —
Maya Singh
Security Manager
Skylark Health

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <security@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report and sharing method

Hi Maya — thanks for reaching out and sorry for the delay. We can absolutely provide the PT report for the Hosted API and an evidence package summarizing scope and remediation status. A few notes up front: 

- The latest full penetration test (redwood_pt_summary_2026_v1.pdf) was completed 2026-10-22 and covers our hosted API fleet, admin console, and the control plane. Customer data was excluded from active exploitation; simulated payloads were used where relevant.
- We maintain a remediation tracker (remediation_tracker_2026-11.xlsx) with statuses for each finding.

Secure delivery options we can offer (pick one):
1) Evidence portal link (recommended) — tenant-scoped access with SSO and audit logs; links expire after 14 days by default, can shorten to 7 days.
2) Presigned S3 object — expiry configurable (we typically suggest 7 days) and we can rotate the AES-256 key before delivery.
3) SFTP account with jumpbox access — time-limited account creation, requires IP allowlist and MFA.

For the full report we usually redact customer-identifying details on request; if you need the unredacted version we require a signed mutual NDA appendix.

Looping in Neha (security) and Aditya (solutions) to confirm redaction policy and to create whichever transfer you prefer. If you want the portal, I will provision a view-only access and send a short onboarding note.

Next steps: tell us your preferred transfer option and whether you need unredacted content (and we will route the NDA if so).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, Maya Singh <security@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report and sharing method

Thanks for the tag, Sergio. Maya — short answers from the security team: 

- Scope: production API ingress (load balancers), API gateway, backend inference workers (no customer PII was used), auth services (token flows), and the control plane management endpoints. Network layer testing was limited to internal VPC ranges; no physical or datacenter tests were performed.

- Redaction: we can provide a redacted PDF immediately (removing customer IDs and IPs). For unredacted report access we require a signed addendum to the existing NDA and we will provision via the evidence portal only.

- Remediation summary: see attached tracker — we have 3 medium findings in progress (ETA for fixes: 2026-11-30) and the rest marked resolved. We will include a remediation note per finding in the portal.

Preferred transfer: evidence portal (audit trail + SSO). If you need presigned S3 instead, we will use a 7-day link and rotate keys after you confirm receipt.

I will prepare the portal workspace and add Skylark Health as a view-only identity provider SSO user if you confirm the email address to grant.

-Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

[Attachment: remediation_tracker_2026-11.xlsx]
From: Maya Singh <security@skylarkhealth.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Mendes <it-ops@skylarkhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report and sharing method

Thanks — portal sounds good. Please provision a view-only access for security@skylarkhealth.com (we use Okta SSO). We accept the redacted PDF for now; once our legal team validates the mutual addendum we may request unredacted access.

A couple quick asks before you provision: 
- Can you confirm whether the API tests included the multi-tenant routing layer? We need to ensure our integration surface is covered.
- Please set portal link expiry to 7 days and enable download audit logging.

Once provisioned, I will confirm receipt and share any follow-up questions.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Security Manager
Skylark Health
